components.title: Emby cast service
components.description: For the app Emby: the head unit as a cast target in the Emby phone app (Emby's remote control, as Kodi's Emby add-on), and the film's player: the server sends H.264 up to 1080p with AAC or AC-3, decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file (the app shows it while parked) and played into SmartXbar's CarLife input. Signs in once from the phone (a page on the car Wi-Fi, opened from the app's QR code); keeps only the access token. Its internet goes through mgu-uplink, as uid 13101 only; the player runs as nobody (as AirPlay Test's receiver).
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: TVH service
components.description: For the app TVH: Tvheadend's channels on the head unit. The channel comes with one of the server's transcoding profiles (mgu-hd, mgu-sd, mgu-low: H.264 deinterlaced by the server, AAC, MPEG-TS), is decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file (the app shows it while parked) and played into SmartXbar's CarLife input. Signs in once from the phone (a page on the car Wi-Fi, opened from the app's QR code); keeps the server, the user and the password (root's, 0600). Its internet goes through mgu-uplink, as uid 13103 only; the player runs as nobody.
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: Emby
components.description: The head unit as a cast target for the Emby phone app: sign in once from the phone (QR code), then choose "BMW iDrive" in Emby's cast menu. The film plays on the centre screen while parked, its sound on the car's speakers; pause, seek and stop from the phone. Needs the Emby cast service.

components.title: TVH
components.description: Tvheadend's TV channels on the centre screen: sign in once from the phone (QR code), then Watch, Channel + / -, or the channel list over the picture. The picture shows while parked, the sound plays on the car's speakers. The server transcodes (profiles mgu-hd, mgu-sd, mgu-low: H.264 deinterlaced, AAC) and the profile goes down by itself when the internet is slow. Needs the TVH service.
